reserved_fault_rule: all TEP fault IDs 1--20 except method-development faults 3, 9, and 15
primary_feature_gate: two-sided 95% independent-run bootstrap CI excludes zero AND global BH q<=0.05 across all 260 candidates for that fault
family_choice_rule: among eligible families maximize the median absolute Hedges g of the selected Top-5; break exact ties by the frozen family priority
orientation_rule: sign of the development-minus-normal run-mean shift
normal_reference: normal training for PCA; normal validation for screening
raw_container_caveat: pyreadr materializes the complete TEP_Faulty_Testing.RData object, but Step 21 only subsets and analyzes runs 1--250
planned_frozen_evaluation: a separate script must verify this Step-21 script/config and then evaluate the frozen per-fault branch on runs 251--500
